title: Intervention (chaos construction, intervening cells)
author: Chilly
rules:
This puzzle is part of the puzzle pack Chaotic Construction by the Sudoku Skunkworks. Please check it out!

Intervention - by Chilly

Rules:

Chaos Construction: Divide the grid into regions of 7 orthogonally connected cells each, such that every cell is part of exactly one region. Place the digits 1 to 7 exactly once in each row, column and region.

Intervening cells: An arrow in a cell indicates that a target cell, belonging to the same region, lies in the direction of the arrow directly after a segment of cells from different regions. That segment of intervening cells does not necessarily have to start directly after the arrow cell.

Intervention count: Either the arrow cell or its target cell must contain the number of intervening cells between the arrow cell and the target cell.

7x7 example (not playable) showing target cells with dotted circles.

SudokuPad - Penpa+
solutionCode: Row 4 with a '-' for each region border, not including grid edges.
